This task is now at root level, by coordinator decision. It was a child of friended-brainsick-degus (ebf5-5d21-0124-4313), and its `depends_on` f7dc-132b-057a-476c escalated to that epic, which made the epic and all 8 of its stories unclaimable.

It now depends on f7dc-132b-057a-476c directly, so it stays gated on the dependency advisories. It records `discovered_from` the epic and from gunshy-symmetric-barnacle for provenance.

Land it after f7dc closes, or bundle it into the change that remediates those advisories.
